data_description.comfort_temperature: Empty = room type default. Used on first start and when switching on a room that was off.
data_description.setback_short: When all residents are away (after the delay). Suggested: living rooms 18 °C, bedroom 16 °C.

data_description.calibration_mode: Offset: the TRV continuously gets a correction value so it 'sees' the room temperature (recommended). Setpoint: the TRV setpoint is adjusted – for TRVs without offset.
data_description.off_method: Auto picks the right method. Tuya TRVs: usually 'preset off'.
data_description.on_preset: The TRV must regulate to the sent setpoint in this preset. Auto picks e.g. 'eco' and avoids 'on' – on the TRV602Z 'on' means valve permanently open.
data_description.follow_trv_changes: Off: changes on the device are reverted (like a child lock).

data_description.sync_verify_delay: Then it is checked whether the TRV applied the command; otherwise it is repeated with growing intervals. Helps with short connection drops.
data_description.sensor_stale_minutes: Afterwards the TRV uses its own sensor and the status shows a warning.

data_description.tts_targets_hub: Announcement only when the room cools down or after repeated reminders, never in quiet hours.
data_description.quiet_start: Silent push only during quiet hours.
data_description.weather_entity: Used for airing time, heating limit and mold guard.
data_description.notify_on_failure: Message in the Home Assistant bell.

data_description.residents: Counts as soon as any of their phones is in the zone. Impossible jumps (e.g. VPN) and inaccurate fixes are ignored.
data_description.away_delay: So a short errand doesn't trigger anything.
data_description.preheat_km: If someone approaches within this distance, heating starts early. 0 = off.

data_description.season_mode: Automatic: by season and outdoor temperature. Always / pause: manual.
data_description.heating_limit: Above this mean of the last 24 h and the forecast the heating pauses (after 2 mild days).
data_description.cold_snap_temp: Outside the season heating runs if the daily mean stays below for 3 days.
data_description.frost_floor: If a room drops below, it heats even during the pause.
data_description.valve_care: Wednesdays 11:00 during the pause: open valves for 3 minutes so they don't seize.
